mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_shipping_rule(merchant_id) VALUES(#{merchantId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE merchant_id=merchant_id
mapper.select: SELECT merchant_id,fee_cents,version FROM merchant_shipping_rule WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_hash,merchant_id,fee_cents,rule_version FROM shipping_rule_command WHERE actor_id=#{actor} AND request_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_shipping_rule SET fee_cents=#{fee},version=version+1 WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_group(group_no,user_id,idempotency_key,request_hash) VALUES(#{groupNo},#{userId},#{key},#{hash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_no=group_no
mapper.select: SELECT group_no,user_id,request_hash,created_at FROM trade_group WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT group_no,user_id,created_at FROM trade_group WHERE group_no=#{groupNo}

SELECT c.merchant_id AS merchantId,c.order_no AS orderNo,COALESCE(o.status,i.state) AS status,i.result_code AS resultCode,o.total_amount_cents AS amountCents,s.shipping_cents AS shippingCents FROM trade_group_child c JOIN order_creation_intent i ON i.order_no=c.order_no LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_no=c.order_no LEFT JOIN order_charge_snapshot s ON s.order_no=c.order_no WHERE c.group_no=#{groupNo} ORDER BY c.merchant_id
SELECT group_no,user_id,created_at FROM trade_group WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,group_no DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT order_no AS orderNo,user_id AS userId,merchant_id AS merchantId,status,completed_at AS receivedAt,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_item i JOIN order_item_unit u ON u.order_item_id=i.id WHERE i.order_no=o.order_no AND (u.active_aftersale_no IS NOT NULL OR u.reserved_refund_cents>0)) AS hasActiveAftersale FROM orders o WHERE order_no=#{orderNo}
SELECT from_status AS fromStatus,to_status AS toStatus,operation AS eventType,reason,created_at AS createdAt FROM order_status_log WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} ORDER BY id
SELECT order_no FROM orders WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
